header.gameNote: NCAA Women's Championship - Regional 2 in Birmingham - 2nd Round

videos.headline: Maryland beats Alabama in double-overtime thriller
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker scores 45 points for Alabama, but Maryland holds on to win in double overtime.

tracking.trackingName: COM_NCW Highlight (Maryland beats Alabama in double-overtime thriller) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sarah Ashlee Barker sets Alabama record with 43 points
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker scores her 43rd point with an overtime bucket, setting an Alabama record.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Sarah Ashlee Barker sets Alabama record with 43 points) 2025/3/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Highlight: Barker makes history but Bama falls short in 2OT battle vs. Maryland
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker scores a career-high 45 points, the most by any SEC player and fourth-most by any player in NCAA Tournament history, but the Tide drop a 111-108 loss to the Terrapins.

videos.headline: Sarah Ashlee Barker hits a 3 for Alabama
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker sinks a 3-pointer in the first quarter for Alabama.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Sarah Ashlee Barker nails it from behind the arc) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sarah Te-Biasu steals and scores for Maryland
videos.description: Sarah Te-Biasu intercepts a pass and goes the other way for a Maryland layup.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Sarah Te-Biasu makes a great defensive play for the steal) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Essence Cody answers with and-1 bucket for Alabama
videos.description: Essence Cody absorbs contact and scores a basket plus a foul for Alabama.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Essence Cody answers with and-1 bucket for Alabama) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kaylene Smikle forces an Alabama timeout with a great individual play
videos.description: Kaylene Smikle steals the ball, then takes it up the court for a Maryland basket.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kaylene Smikle forces an Alabama timeout with a great individual play) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Weathers fires a pass to Barker for an Alabama trey
videos.description: Karly Weathers flings a pass to Sarah Ashlee Barker for an Alabama 3-pointer.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Weathers fires a pass to Barker for an Alabama trey) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Aaliyah Nye grabs long rebound and drills a 3
videos.description: Aaliyah Nye gets the long rebound and knocks down a 3-pointer for Alabama.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Aaliyah Nye grabs long rebound and drills a 3) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sarah Ashlee Barker fired up after putting Bama up 14
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker sinks another 3-pointer as Alabama goes up 14 on Maryland.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Sarah Ashlee Barker fired up after putting Bama up 14) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sarah Te-Biasu brings Maryland closer with a 3
videos.description: Sarah Te-Biasu closes out the third quarter with a 3-pointer for the Terrapins.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Sarah Te-Biasu brings Maryland closer with a 3) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Shyanne Sellers hits a big 3-pointer for Maryland
videos.description: Maryland continues to chip away at Alabama's lead as Shyanne Sellers hits a corner triple.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Shyanne Sellers hits a big 3-pointer for Maryland) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Alabama, Maryland trade big 3s late
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker continues her big game with a 3-pointer, then Sarah Te-Biasu answers to bring Maryland even with Alabama.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Alabama, Maryland trade big 3s late) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Kaylene Smikle gets big OT and-1 for Maryland
videos.description: Kaylene Smikle gets the hoop and harm for Maryland in overtime.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Kaylene Smikle gets big OT and-1 for Maryland) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Alabama cashes in on Maryland's late foul with 3 FTs to force 2OT
videos.description: Sarah Ashlee Barker gets fouled shooting a triple. and she hits all three free throws to force double-overtime.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Alabama cashes in on Maryland's late foul with 3 FTs to force 2OT) 2025/03/24 ESHEET

videos.headline: Maryland stops Alabama on final possession to reach Sweet 16
videos.description: Maryland doesn't let Alabama get a shot off on the final play of double overtime to move on to play South Carolina in the Sweet 16.

tracking.trackingName: NCW_One-Play (Maryland stops Alabama on final possession to reach Sweet 16) 2025/03/24 ESHEET
